hero.filename: Alain Manesson Mallet - circa 1685 - The Islet Guanahani or San Salvador - Fig 22.jpg
hero.caption: Scanned in from Mallet's five-volume world atlas.  This page shows the islet of Guanahani, which is part of San Salvador, the first landfall island of Columbus in 1492.

images.filename: Pierre Duflos - Christophe Colomb faisant saisir le cacique de Guanahani..jpg
images.caption: Christopher Colombus seizing the Guanahani cacique. Etching, between 1774 and 1783, 18,3 x 13,5 cm. This print was published in La découverte du Nouveau Monde, by Jean-Jacques Rousseau. The characters where the cacique of Guanahan island, Digizé, his wife, and Christopher Colombus. National Gallery of Art, Washington, D.C.
